Jack Morrow — a former combat medic wrongfully convicted of treason and buried in a black-site prison called Ashworth Federal Penitentiary — has spent six years rotting in a concrete cell with no trial, no appeal, and no hope, until a shadowy government operative named Director Elias Hargrove arrives with an offer: survive a classified experimental serum injection under a program called Project Goliath, and walk out a free man with a full pardon and a new identity. Desperate and with nothing left to lose, Morrow signs the document and is transported to Site Prometheus — a massive underground research facility hidden beneath the Utah salt flats — where lead geneticist Dr. Lena Vasik injects him with a dark silvery-green gamma serum that has already killed thirty-one previous test subjects, but this time something different happens: Morrow doesn't die — his veins turn black, his skin shifts to dark stone-grey, his hair falls away leaving a bald skull mapped with pulsing veins, and he transforms into something the military never imagined — the Grey Hulk, the first successful survivor of Project Goliath, stronger and smarter than anything they've ever created. But when Morrow discovers that the freedom he was promised was a lie — that the documents he signed were consent-to-terminate forms and every test subject was scheduled for disposal regardless of survival — he makes a decision: he's not their weapon, he's not their experiment, and he's not dying in this facility, igniting a brutal breakout through the underground corridors of Site Prometheus, a jungle warfare campaign against an entire military task force sent to hunt him down, and a final desperate airstrike that fails to stop something that was never meant to be stopped. With the help of Dr. Vasik — who risks everything to expose the truth about Section 9's crimes — Grey Hulk escapes into the wilderness, but Hargrove is already planning Phase 2 with two hundred new subjects, and deep in the wreckage of the destroyed facility, something else is waking up — Roman Volkov, the man Grey Hulk left for dead, is transforming into something darker, something more savage, something called KLUH.
Matt Damon as Jack Morrow / Grey Hulk
Anthony Hopkins as Director Elias Hargrove
Angelina Jolie as Dr. Lena Vasik
Keanu Reeves as Roman Volkov / Kluh

Like you just know I’m gonna 
Walk out, walk out, on love

We can’t keep talking 
Now you know 
It’s more than I can feel right now. 

Yeah 
Don’t give in to loneliness 
When everything is such a mess
Just hold me in your arms 

Yeah 
I don’t want the world from you
I’m just wanting something true 
Far from these alarms 

Yeah 
I know you tried to warn me but
I could’ve called but it’s a lot 
I never knew the harm

Yeah 
Is nothing sacred nothing blessed 
Is every god damn thing a test
Just hold me in your arms 

It is no lie
It was something you said 
That we live or die
On the things we did instead 
Of our heart’s desire 

Fell in love with the danger 
It’s only getting stranger
We can’t keep breaking 
Everything shaking 
Apart in our hands right now

snippet.title: KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS Official Trailer
snippet.description:
KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS in cinemas worldwide with limited screenings from August 12. 
tickets now on sale at http://katseyewildheartsfilm.com/

Two-time GRAMMY®-nominated global girl group KATSEYE is coming to cinemas worldwide with a special theatrical release ahead of their third EP, WILD.

KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS is a captivating journey into the group's bold new era while celebrating the fans who helped make it possible. Featuring never-before-seen footage, EYEKONS fan videos, and intimate interviews from the group members, the film explores the powerful bond between KATSEYE and their global fandom. A love letter to the EYEKONS who helped build this movement, KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS reveals why this group's story is only just beginning.

From the intense pressure of Dream Academy to chart-topping viral success, audiences experience the highs, setbacks, sacrifices, and breakthrough moments that transformed KATSEYE on their path to global pop stardom. Praised by outlets including The New York Times, Vogue, Rolling Stone, and Billboard, KATSEYE has earned acclaim for their relentless dedication to their craft and electrifying live performances. As one of pop's most exciting emerging global acts, the group continues to solidify its place as a worldwide force.

From the same team that created Netflix’s POP STAR ACADEMY, KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS is produced by Interscope Films and Boardwalk Pictures, in partnership with HYBE X GEFFEN, and directed by Nadia Hallgren.

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community.  Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

snippet.title: I PLAY ROCKY | Official Trailer HD
snippet.description:
Directed by: Peter Farrelly
Starring: Anthony Ippolito, Matt Dillon, AnnaSophia Robb, P.J. Byrne, Toby Kebbell, Tracy Letts, Jay Duplass and Kiki Seto

The film is an electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky – he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told 'no' at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds. The result is the ultimate underdog story behind the ultimate underdog movie.

Told 'no' at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds. The result is the ultimate underdog story behind the ultimate underdog movie.

snippet.title: Young Ghost & Tommy Exclusive First Look & Teaser Breakdown | Power Origins Season 1
snippet.description:
In this video we break down the first official teaser for Power Origins — the highly anticipated origin story of Ghost, Tommy, and Kanan as ambitious young entrepreneurs on the rise in the streets of New York City.

Created by 50 Cent and brought to life by Sascha Penn (the same mastermind behind Raising Kanan Season 5), Power Origins delivers a fun, rambunctious look at how legends are made. We get our first real look at young Ghost and Tommy in action — talking shit, dreaming big, and causing absolute mayhem as they prove they can do this on their own.

From the car scenes where Ghost lays out his vision to the wild baseball-bat energy with Tommy, we dissect every frame. We also dive into how Ghost and Tommy first cross paths with a more seasoned Kanan, the timeline connection to Raising Kanan Season 5, the role of Breeze, and why this younger, hungrier version of Ghost is going to be very different from the smooth operator we knew in the original Power series.

Sascha Penn has already proven he knows how to cast these roles perfectly with Raising Kanan Season 5, and the early signs are that Spencer Moore as young Ghost and Charlie Mann as Tommy are going to kill it. The brotherhood, the betrayals, the trials, and the unbridled audacity — it’s all here.
Comment your thoughts — I’ll be in the comments too!

From director-producer Wolfgang Petersen (Poseidon, Das Boot) comes Troy, an epic tale of love, war and devastation. Adapted from Homer’s classic poem The Iliad, Troy demonstrates the undeniable gravitas and inevitability of Homer’s narrative even after millennia.

When Helen of Sparta (Diane Kruger), though married, elopes with the Trojan prince Paris (Orlando Bloom) and flees to Troy, they’re followed by war of unimaginable proportions. Helen’s husband Menelaus (Brendan Gleeson) summons a united army of Greece led by the arrogant Agamemnon (Brian Cox) and driven forward by the bold and courageous Achilles (Brad Pitt). As the armies of Greece and Troy clash, so too do their greatest champions – Achilles and Hector (Eric Bana) in a conflict that brings devastation to both kingdoms. In this colossal epic, witness huge battlescapes, one-on-one duels worthy of a Colosseum and the fall of a once-great nation.

Prepare to witness the gargantuan scale of this legendary fable in stunning 4K for the first time, courtesy of a brand new restoration. Experience this legendary saga of heroes, battles and tragedies, all in more glory than ever before.

snippet.description:

🛑 Multumiri speciale :
Giulia  
Contact : https://www.instagram.com/giuliapopmusic


Artist interpret: Adrian Tutu /Giulia
Muzica: Adrian Tutu / Giulia
Text: Adrian Tutu
Mix/Master: Adrian Tutu
Filmat de : MYCREWVISION
Montat de : Adrian Tutu

Versuri : 

Refren: 

Orice mi-ar zice ei n-ar conta 
Fara tine n-are rost viata mea 
Zilele ce trec ma fac sa inteleg 
Ca orice mi-ar da ei tot pe tine te aleg

Strofa 1: 

Tot pe tine te-as alege dintr-un milion de sanse
Esti tot viitorul meu in toate zilele ramase
Ne-am jurat iubire in fata lui Dumnezeu
Am stiut ca pe vecie vom ramane tu si eu

Tu imi dai putere esti tot ceea ce iubesc
Imi esti toata fericirea cand te admir si te privesc
am jurat ca o sa ma lupt pentru noi si zi si noapte
Pentru tine in orice clipa as lasa totul in spate

Ti-as da ochii mei sa vezi cat de mult tin la tine
Si mai stiu ceva c-ai da totul pentru mine
Ti-am mai zis iunire nu o sa te las nu 
Ca i-am cerut vietii fericitre si-ai aparut tu 

Refren: 

Orice mi-ar zice ei n-ar conta 
Fara tine n-are rost viata mea 
Zilele ce trec ma fac sa inteleg 
Ca orice mi-ar da ei tot pe tine te aleg

Strofa 2:
Eu cand te-am ales pe tine tu cand m-ai ales pe mine 
Nu stiam ca din iubire vom lupta fara oprire 
Esti sprijinul meu mereu cand viata ne incearca 
Ne tinem unu de altu ca niciunu sa nu cada

Daca vad zambetul tau nu-mi mai trebuie nimic
oricat sunt de suparat uit de tot si ma ridic
De cand tu de mana mea si de sufletul meu te-ai prins
Am stiut ca ce-avem noi pentru altii este vis

Te-as alege inca o data daca as mai venii pe aici
Findca impreuna am invins atatea frici
Noi suntem la infinit inca din prima zi
Te-as alege tot pe tine oricate vieti as primii

Refren: 

Orice mi-ar zice ei n-ar conta 
Fara tine n-are rost viata mea 
Zilele ce trec ma fac sa inteleg 
Ca orice mi-ar da ei tot pe tine te aleg

Dropped on a snowy island teeming with dinosaurs off the coast of Siberia, you must run, fight, or hide from a massive lineup of unique dinosaurs, from Terror Birds to Baryonyx, using a huge range of big guns.
The island offers open-world gameplay, your mission is to kill the evil Commodore who calls the island his home. The region also boasts the reigning Masters London champions and the current VALORANT Champions winners.
Now, the stakes are higher than ever. Every team enters Stage 2 with one objective: secure a spot at VALORANT Champions Shanghai.
Leviatán enters Stage 2 riding high after its Masters London triumph. NRG is ready to remind the world why it has long been considered a global powerhouse. Meanwhile, G2 Esports aims to defend its VCT Americas crown and add another championship to its trophy case.
We’re proud to work with our fantastic partners throughout 2026: ExpressVPN, HP, Pulsar, Red Bull, Samsung, Secretlab, Verizon, and Zowie.

snippet.title: MODERN WARFARE 4 MULTIPLAYER GAMEPLAY REVEAL LIVE: FULL MW4 MULTIPLAYER GAMEPLAY!
snippet.description:
NEW OFFICIAL MW4 MULTIPLAYER GAMEPLAY REVEAL LIVE: FANATICS FEST SHOWCASE!
►Excited for Modern Warfare 4?  Hit 👍 LIKE and ✅ Subscribe - Thank you!
►https://youtu.be/QPodRmy6GtM?si=A1NRaV_oc3aWsFHp
►Please show some love to all the streamers we're watching from Fanatics Fest!

See fresh Modern Warfare 4 gameplay featuring new environments and detailed weapon inspections. Get a closer look at the M4 rifle. This footage provides an early look at the latest Modern Warfare 4 environments and combat mechanics. If you are a fan of FPS titles, this breakdown offers a clear view of how the game handles movement and weapon fidelity in current development builds. We focus specifically on the weapon arsenal, highlighting the updated M4 rifle model and how it interacts with different map layouts. By examining these Modern Warfare 4 clips, you can better understand the visual direction and mechanical focus of the upcoming release. Today we have ACTUAL MW4 Multiplayer Gameplay showcasing the new gunplay in MW4. Developed by Infinity Ward, Modern Warfare 4 marks a new chapter for the studio with the grounded, authentic, high-stakes military action Modern Warfare is known for. Players can expect the edge and intensity that define Modern Warfare, delivered with a renewed focus on authenticity and immersion across Campaign, Multiplayer, and DMZ. Set against a rapidly escalating global conflict centered on the Korean Peninsula, Modern Warfare 4 pushes the series into darker and more dangerous territory as a full-scale invasion of South Korea threatens to destabilize the world. Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer delivers grounded, precise combat where fluid movement, player choice, and greater control define every engagement. Ballistic Authority: For Modern Warfare 4, a new weapon-first technology stack unifies precision aiming, physical handling, realistic audio propagation, enhanced visibility, and smarter combat perception into the most authentic Modern Warfare gunplay yet. Bullet trajectory, weapon motion, Operator stance, camera, audio, FOV, and target visibility all line up in one highly tuned combat fidelity system. The promise is simple: no bloom, no guesswork, and no doubt. Every shot tells the truth. Precision tuned combat, where every system is finely tuned to create a seamless connection between player, weapon, and combat. Weapon bloom has been removed from hipfire, making shots feel more connected to where the weapon is pointed while delivering consistent, predictable, and fair gunplay. Movement is grounded and built for fluid transitions and greater control, giving players new ways to push forward, change angles, and adapt under pressure. On day one, players will deploy across 12 all-new core 6v6 maps set in visually and tactically distinct locations around the world, built to support a range of playstyles from tight close-quarters combat to more open engagements. Beyond the core 6v6 offering, Multiplayer also features dedicated Gunfight maps, multiple Big War maps built for vehicle and infantry combat, and Kill Block, a dynamic battleground with more than 500 configurations that reshape routes, sightlines, and cover to keep players adapting round after round. The all-new Gunny system brings a Gunnery Sergeant’s eye weapon customization, helping players quickly assemble effective builds based on their preferred playstyle and unlocked attachments. Expanded, streamlined customization puts more control in players’ hands, with a unified loadout system, robust Gunsmith, and more weapons, equipment, and killstreaks at launch. Apex Attachments unlock at max weapon progression, evolving each weapon with new behaviors that open up additional tactical playstyles.

snippet.title: Meet Exfauxdia: My TCG-Locked Hardcore Ironman (Cardcore Ep. 1)
snippet.description:
Limited Edition OSRS PC, Keyboard, Wall-Art, Mousepad and Case at https://starforgepc.com/Faux

Exfauxdia Cardcore: The rules are not a perfect science since this is so new. I'll be using logic and reason to mould these as we go, and will sometimes leave the decision up to the chat for fairness sake when I see fit.


- Earn credits by gaining experience, leveling, or killing NPCs
- Spend credits to open card packs (2500 credits per pack)
- CAN only use items that you have a card for
- CAN only attack NPCs that you have a card for
- CAN speak to NPCs that you don't have a card for
- CANNOT attack NPCs that you don't have a card for
- Mistakes will happen, but will require a reasonable punish ment agreed upon by chat
- Quests require all required items to be unlocked. If an NPC fight occurs, must have that NPC unlocked if the card exists
- Content that doesn't have an associated card is assumed unlocked


- FOIL Cards unlocks: Foil cards are rare enough that they should be exciting, anticipated, and feel rewarding.
 - Foil item unlocks all items including and BELOW that card tier (example: Foil mith axe also unlocks bronze-black axe, but not addy+)
 - Foil boss unlocks all unique collection logs of that boss (example: Foil General Graardor unlocks all Bandos armor, Bandos hilt, shards)
 - Foil items on a case by case basis unlock horizontally instead of vertically (Foil god d'hide shield unlocks other god d'hide shields, but not all tiers below)

snippet.title: Bungie has One More Surprise Gift for Destiny 2 Players...
snippet.description:
New Destiny 2 News after what was supposed to be the latest TWAB (TWID) on July 16 in Destiny 2: Monument of Triumph (June Update). Will this Delayed Weekly Update EVER Come? Well Bungie Surprised Destiny 2 Players with yet another Farewell Gift! Giving Players one more chance to get Special Bungie Rewards, and More!
--FOLLOW ME ON TWITCH: https://www.twitch.tv/kackishd

--- My Twitter: https://twitter.com/RickKackis

New #destiny2 video, going over the latest Destiny 2 News from the New Weekly Update (What was supposed to be the final TWAB aka Final TWID) on July 16 in the new Monument of Triumph Update, the New Destiny 2 Update with Destiny 2 Ending, after the Launch of the New Destiny 2 Renegades Expansion!  Monument of Triumph is here and we have the Destiny 2 News from the New TWAB (This week at Bungie) or TWID (This Week in Destiny), during Destiny 2 Monument of Triumph! This is after Destiny 2: Renegades, and The Edge of Fate DLC.
The Renegades Expansion brought a new Campaign, and the "Lawless Frontiers" Activity! Pledge to the different Syndicates (Totality Division, The Pikers, or Tharsis Reformation), and complete Bounties in the Lawless Frontier, secure Contested Zones, and fend off Invaders! Get the new Praxic Blade Exotic Sword (Destiny 2 Lightsaber), and play the new Equilibrium Dungeon! 
But now We have the Monument Of Triumph! The Last Destiny 2 Update Ever! It brings Pantheon 2.0 (Calus Resplendent and Morgeth Surpassing) As well as Updated Destinations, New Exotic Catalysts, the new Secret Exotic Quest and Secret Exotic Mission for the Cull's Shadow, Sparrow Racing League (SRL), and more!
But today we're going over the new Destiny 2 news from the New Destiny 2 Reset, and more! We have new featured raids and dungeons with absolutely god tier armor that will be tier 5! Last week we had the last patch ever! We also have a free god roll Sarpedon-D! But Bungie also gave away 7 Free Emblems, new destiny 2 Emblems, for Bungie Day, and not Bungie has yet another gift to Destiny 2 Players, Restocking some Bungie Rewards we NEVER expected to see again!
 #destiny2news #gaming

When Steve's body gets transformed into HOUSEHEAD like the Bunker Head, Bank Head, Gym Head, and more, he needs to UPGRADE himself by entering the mysterious portals! Minecraft is an open world game that has no specific goals for the player to accomplish, allowing players a large amount of freedom in choosing how to play the game however, there is an achievement system. The gameplay by default is first person, but players have the option to play in third person mode. The core gameplay revolves around breaking and placing blocks. The game world is essentially composed of rough 3D objects—mainly cubes—that are arranged in a fixed grid pattern and represent different materials, such as dirt, stone, various ores, water, and tree trunks. While players can move freely across the world, objects and items can only be placed at fixed locations relative to the grid. Players can gather these material blocks and place them elsewhere, thus allowing for various constructions.
